notes.title: Prehistoric Showdown
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36864655/6bebaac97952ccb3778a57b9a0773de778e41e56.jpg[/img]

Join this limited-time event to dino-soar to the top of the leaderboard and excavate a pile of in-game rewards.

First time playing in a Showdown? We’ve got you covered with everything you need to know.

[b]Qualifying Round[/b]
[list]
[*] The qualifying round lasts three days
[*] Players have a daily chance each day of the qualifying round to secure their spot in the elimination round
[*] The top 50% of the qualifying round leaderboard advance to the elimination round
[*] Players that qualify on day one (top 50%) do not need to play on day two or three of the qualifying round
[*] Players that do not qualify on day one are still eligible to compete on days two or three to secure an elimination round spot
[/list]
[b]Elimination Round[/b]
[list]
[*] The elimination round lasts two days
[*] Players only get one chance to grab a spot in the final round, unlike the qualifying round
[*] The top 50% of the elimination round leaderboard advance to the final round
[/list]
[b]Final Round[/b]
[list]
[*] The final round also lasts two days
[*] If you’ve made it this far, you’ll receive a prize no matter what, but the higher you rank, the bigger the prizes
[/list]
[b]Other Things to Know[/b]
[list]
[*] We base scoring on total strokes, meaning the fewer shots you take to complete your matches, the higher you rank on the leaderboard
[*] Incomplete or forfeited holes score as bogeys
[/list]

See you out there!

notes.title: Community Update June 2021
notes.content:
Hello and welcome back to WGTChampion’s Corner where I ask you all to gather ‘round and then I ramble about golf video games. I’m glad you still gather. I really appreciate it.

The main things I want to point out:
[olist]
[*] USGA eSports Grand Slam: Virtual Open at Olympic Club live stream date has changed from June 7 to June 12.
[*] We’re upgrading our Unity version so it may be a short while before you see a new client update.
[*] Why is a Unity upgrade important?
[/olist]
Let’s start with number 1. The Virtual Open at Olympic Club live stream will see 10 players compete for big prizes on Olympic Club. It was originally scheduled for Monday June 7, but it has been moved to Saturday, June 12. Saturdays are more fun.  

Number 2! You may have noticed our downtime this week was not followed by an update to download. We were able to bring you the latest Callaway equipment, a Tie Dye shirt, and some new WGT Classics from the server downtime alone without having to download a new update when you launched the game. 

The reason for this is that our engineering team is currently focused on upgrading Unity, the game engine that powers WGT, to a newer version. This update is more behind-the-scenes work, so you shouldn't expect to necessarily see anything new just yet., until we start rolling out the improvements made possible by it.

[i]Is that like when iTunes updates?[/i] It is not. 

There are a number of reasons this update is important, mainly that it will allow us to continue improving the game and your experience, and will make future features possible. It’s a time consuming project to do the upgrade and make sure everything is working correctly, which is why we’re being extremely careful and taking the time needed to do it right. 

When we finish extensive testing and feel comfortable with the update we will be rolling it out one platform at a time as another precaution. We're intentionally rolling it out slowly and when you receive the update, if you think “Wow, none of this seems different at all,” then you’ll know we did our job well.

NUMBER 3! [i]So why is this so important?[/i] For a number of reasons. The biggest reason is that new versions of Unity come with new features that we plan to use in future features and updates. It will help make sure we’re compliant with app store updates and allows us to integrate more services. 

[b]BONUS![/b] Rapid fire round!

[list]
[*] We have two server downtimes scheduled for June. These are currently scheduled for the nights of June 22 and June 29. The June 22 downtime is for maintenance and the June 29 one is our normal downtime. Keep an eye out for formal announcements on those days. 
[*] Another round of WGT Classic apparel released earlier this week. We’re hoping to get some more out at the end of June. Sorry they haven’t been coming out as frequently as we originally planned. Releasing Torrey Pines was the priority and delayed the rollout but we’re getting back on track. 
[*] The first Showdown Rush starts this Saturday, May 29. There’s only one round of qualifiers so don’t wait to enter! 
[*] The Tie Dye shirt is super cool. 
[*] Torrey Pines will be added to all your favorite game modes at the end of June. That means coin games, match play, alt shot, single player rounds, country club tournaments. But what about [INSERT GAME MODE HERE]? Yes, that one too! Until then, you can play it as many times as you like in the Virtual U.S. Open Qualifier tournament. 
[/list]
Okay, that’s it. That’s the update.

Talk soon,

_CHAMPION

This will allow you to get a clean view of your putts or anywhere else you'd prefer to see without the aim marker box. Note that you cannot drag your aim while the aim box is hidden. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QSnym0k.png[/img]

That's it for my September update. We'll talk soon. 

Thank you for reading and thank you for playing.

Hi everyone, 

It's July! I feel like it's been a blink of an eye since January and somehow a decade since March, but here we are finally, or already, in July. 

We're currently putting the final touches on the new Settings menu that we hope will help players avoid confusion in that area of the game. The new Settings menu will still have all the existing options, PLUS new keybindings, and it adds back the ability to switch your status from online to offline, which was temporarily removed when we merged the old in-game menus into a single left-side menu. This means your "Online Visibility" will now be accessible in both the regular game settings as well as the in-game settings menu.

This new Settings menu is now combined into a single page and I personally find it much easier to navigate and use, especially when it comes to changing your resolution. You'll also find it easier to reach our support channels for when you need help. We expect to release these improvements with our next update at the end of July. 

It goes without saying that we're working on more than just a new settings page, so we'll have more to share on those projects soon. We've got some long-term projects in the works that are focused on helping new players learn the game better, new event types, and new game modes. 

Next week we're launching the Out of This World Showdown, and I must say, it's the best badge we've made so far. Be sure to enter and try to get that badge on your profile.

notes.title: Community Update - June
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Welcome to another WGT community post. “Community update?” “Dev blog?” “Ramblings of someone who has been in too many video meetings this week?” Admittedly, this post is coming out later than I wanted, but I didn't want it to get in the way of the downtime announcements that we’ve had to make recently — which I also want to address here.

Most often we take down the servers so we can deploy new updates, features and fixes on a regular basis. Recently we've encountered some hardware issues that have caused extra downtimes and have required us to replace some hardware.

Our intention is always to limit the amount of time WGT is offline and in the last few weeks we have (unfortunately) had to be much more than normal. We’re all truly sorry for any games that have been interrupted by these issues.

We are planning to have our regular downtime next week and we'll post an announcement for that when we're closer. After that we expect to return to monthly updates, and will minimize the number of additional downtimes as best we can.

Now let's get into the good stuff!

First, let's talk about the items in the last post that we released already:

[list]
[*] [b]Adding additional camera views where possible[/b] - Many courses and holes now have additional views available!
[*][b] Improving the Toptracer box positioning[/b] - The Toptracer stats box is now anchored in the top right of the screen
[*] [b]Adding an "Add friend" option for players in multiplayer lobbies[/b] - Multiplayer lobbies (like Skins, Match Play, Alt Shot) now have this button
[*] [b]Improving the aimer on the minimap[/b] - There are now limits to how far it can be moved, it can no longer be dragged all the way off the screen
[/list]

We're also making some great progress on other items from our last post:

[list]
[*] [b]Improvements when using 1920x1080 in windowed mode[/b] - We have a working version now, and I can say without hesitation that it is much better than the current version. We expect to release it in this state (as a major improvement), while we continue exploring how we can make it perfect.
[*] [b]Improving the options menu to be more intuitive[/b] - We're in the early stages of this. We tried making various changes to the current UI that didn't feel quite good enough, so we're exploring a full redesign that looks more standard to other PC games.
[*] [b]Improving mouse scrolling[/b] - We have a great version of this right now that we expect to release soon. It improves the mouse scrolling from "almost not scrolling at all" to "hey, this is normal scrolling!”
[*] [b]Adding an in-game restart button for rounds that can be replayed[/b] - This is something I get a ton of requests for and I'm happy to say we’re making great progress on it. I expect we’ll be able to release this very soon and I'm happy to be able to stop rage-quitting after I 3-putt on a par 4 and start rage-restarting.
[*] [b]Improving the lobby "ready" timer to better indicate the status of the player[/b] - This one is proving to be a bit trickier than we expected: TBD.
[*] [b]Improving tournament leaderboards[/b] - We have a version now that we've tested a bit and have had really positive feedback from players so far. While it's already a huge improvement, it's not 100% just yet. We may do more tests with it soon, so don't be alarmed if you see a new leaderboard.
[/list]

A couple extra things we’re working on that I wanted to share:
[list]
[*] [b]Keybindings[/b] - Yes you can toggle a camera with spacebar, but what if you could open chat or remove the flagstick? Well you will be able to very soon. The first version of keybindings is coming together. “But what if I want custom keybindings?” That’s coming too, but not in the initial version. We won't have the list in the game for keybindings at launch so expect another post from me after we release with the list of keys and what they do.
[*] [b]In-game menus[/b] - You may ask, [i]why is there a right side and a left side menu?[/i] This is a good question that we wondered too. So we're combining them into ONE left side menu. (You'll also be able to open and close it with the ESC key.)
[/list]

This is not a complete list of what we're working on as we continue making changes and improvements to the game, but we’ll be posting these updates regularly to keep you in the loop.

Thank you for reading and thank you for playing WGT Golf!

_CHAMPION

P.S. Please keep sending us your feedback.
